big_case.notes: Narrow military-justice procedural question: whether a Court of Criminal Appeals may correct, under Article 66(d)(2) UCMJ, a firearms-prohibition First Indorsement added after entry of judgment. The Second Amendment issue was never reached below, the Air Force withdrew the indorsement practice in February 2026, the identical question was denied in a 13-case consolidation in January 2026 over SG opposition, and the denial here drew no writing. Low stakes beyond the petitioner.
